name: Lumentum Holdings

eyebrow.en: Lumentum Holdings Inc. · Common stock · San Jose, California
eyebrow.zh: Lumentum · 普通股 · 加州圣何塞

title.zh: AI 光互连里的激光器。

lede.en: Lumentum makes the lasers, transceivers and optical circuit switches that link GPUs inside AI data centers. Revenue rose 137% to $1.26B last quarter and is guided to $1.6B. On Nov 2 it agreed to sell itself to Marvell for 4.5 Marvell shares each, and both stocks have slumped since.
lede.zh: Lumentum 生产连接 AI 数据中心内 GPU 的激光器、光模块和光路交换机。上季营收增长 137% 至 12.6 亿美元，本季指引 16 亿。11 月 2 日公司同意以每股换 4.5 股 Marvell 股票的方式被 Marvell 收购，此后两只股票双双大跌。

s.zh: FY27 第二季 · 预计，日期待定

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Lumentum is still up about twofold over the year, but has more than halved from its October peak since Marvell's all-stock bid.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。Lumentum 股价一年仍上涨约一倍，但自 Marvell 提出全股票收购以来，已较 10 月高点跌去一半以上。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin (before acquired-intangible amortization) on the right axis. Lumentum's fiscal year ends around July 1. Q4 FY26 GAAP EPS of −$84.65 comes from a one-time $7.8B non-cash charge for converting notes into stock. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率（未计收购无形资产摊销）。Lumentum 财年约在7月1日结束。FY26 第四季 GAAP 每股 −$84.65 源于可转债转股的一次性 78 亿美元非现金费用。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +137% · 连续第9季增长

p.en: A second major NPO/CPO win in Q1 is backed by more than $5B of purchase commitments, on top of the 1.6T transceiver ramp expected through 2027.
p.zh: 第一季拿下第二个重大 NPO/CPO 项目，背后有逾 50 亿美元采购承诺，此外 1.6T 光模块预计在 2027 年持续放量。

p.en: Systems revenue more than tripled to $508M on OCS shipments. Management says OCS visibility has widened and it could become a multi-billion-dollar annual business.
p.zh: 受 OCS 出货带动，系统业务营收增长逾两倍至 5.08 亿美元。管理层称 OCS 需求能见度扩大，有望成为年营收数十亿美元的业务。

p.en: Holders get a fixed 4.5 Marvell shares each with no collar, so the stock now tracks Marvell. Shareholder votes and antitrust reviews remain; closing is expected in the first half of 2028.
p.zh: 股东每股固定换取 4.5 股 Marvell 股票且无价格保护，股价因此跟随 Marvell。仍需双方股东投票及反垄断审查，预计 2028 年上半年完成。

p.en: Supply, not demand, still limits growth. Capex rose to $230M in Q1 and free cash flow slipped to $38M; note conversions and RSU tax payments cut cash to $2.0B.
p.zh: 制约增长的仍是供给而非需求。第一季资本开支升至 2.3 亿美元，自由现金流降至 3800 万；可转债转换及限制性股票代扣税使现金降至 20 亿美元。

p.en: About $1.3B of convertible notes remain, and shares outstanding rose to 90.7M plus 2.9M preferred. GAAP EPS of $3.54 absorbed an $89M stock-award charge.
p.zh: 仍有约 13 亿美元可转债，流通股增至 9070 万股，另有 290 万股优先股。GAAP 每股 $3.54 已计入 8900 万美元股权激励费用。

p.en: About 21× annualized Q2 guided earnings after the stock more than halved from its October high. Optical stocks swing hard on AI capex headlines, so position sizing matters.
p.zh: 股价较 10 月高点跌去一半以上后，约为 Q2 年化指引盈利的 21 倍。光通信股随 AI 资本开支新闻剧烈波动，仓位控制很重要。

p.en: Virtual meeting to elect directors and vote on executive pay.
p.zh: 线上会议，选举董事并就高管薪酬投票。

p.en: Expected; date not yet set. Guide: $1.575–1.625B revenue, 45–46% non-GAAP operating margin, EPS $5.90–6.20.
p.zh: 预计，日期未定。指引：营收 15.75–16.25 亿美元，非GAAP营业利润率 45–46%，每股 $5.90–6.20。

p.en: Target: first $100M+ quarter for ultra-high-power lasers.
p.zh: 目标：超高功率激光器首个单季逾 1 亿美元收入。

p.en: Expected after shareholder votes and regulatory approvals.
p.zh: 预计在双方股东投票及监管批准后完成。

sources: Q1 FY27 results and Q2 guide (Lumentum IR)
Q1 beat vs consensus and Q2 guide vs estimates (Motley Fool)
Price and consensus: daily closes (Stocklake) and MarketBeat estimates, as of Nov 5, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 5, 2026 (Q1 FY27 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Lumentum Holdings Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月5日（FY27 第一季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Lumentum Holdings Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q2 FY22 to Q1 FY27. Lumentum's fiscal year ends around July 1. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第二季至 FY27 第一季共 20 个季度。Lumentum 财年约在7月1日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年9月 · 剩余可转债约 13 亿

read.en: Lumentum spent most of 2023 to 2025 near break-even on cash as telecom demand slumped. AI optics turned it around, lifting free cash flow to $196M in Q4 FY26. It slipped to $38M in Q1 FY27: operating cash flow of $268M lagged $534M of non-GAAP operating income, and capex rose to $230M.
read.zh: 2023 至 2025 年电信需求低迷，Lumentum 现金流大多在盈亏平衡附近。AI 光通信扭转局面，FY26 第四季自由现金流升至 1.96 亿美元。FY27 第一季回落至 3800 万：经营现金流 2.68 亿美元，远低于 5.34 亿的非GAAP营业利润，资本开支升至 2.3 亿。

read.en: Using Q2 FY27 guidance ($1.6B revenue at about 45% operating margin) and capex of about $240–270M a quarter, I estimate $210–410M of free cash flow a quarter, roughly $1.3B over four quarters. Cash fell $759M in Q1 mainly because of $493M of note-conversion payments and $307M of RSU tax withholding, not operations.
read.zh: 按 FY27 第二季指引（营收 16 亿美元、营业利润率约 45%）及每季约 2.4–2.7 亿美元资本开支，我估计每季自由现金流 2.1–4.1 亿美元，四季合计约 13 亿。第一季现金减少 7.59 亿，主要因可转债转换支付 4.93 亿及限制性股票代扣税 3.07 亿，而非经营所致。

p.en: Capex was $230M in Q1, up from $167M, for laser, transceiver and OCS lines serving AI customers.
p.zh: 第一季资本开支 2.3 亿美元（上季 1.67 亿），用于服务 AI 客户的激光器、光模块与 OCS 产线。

p.en: $493M was paid to settle note conversions in Q1; about $1.3B, mostly 2032 notes, remains.
p.zh: 第一季支付 4.93 亿美元结算可转债转换；仍余约 13 亿，主要为 2032 年到期债券。

p.en: $307M of taxes paid on net-settled stock awards in Q1; there were no buybacks.
p.zh: 第一季为净额结算的股票奖励代缴税款 3.07 亿美元；本季未回购股票。

h.zh: AI 激光器、OCS 与光模块

p.en: Q2 FY27 is guided to about $1.6B of revenue, roughly $350M more than Q1.
p.zh: FY27 第二季营收指引约 16 亿美元，较第一季增加约 3.5 亿。

p.en: Non-GAAP operating margin is guided to 45–46%, up from 42.3%.
p.zh: 非GAAP营业利润率指引 45–46%，高于 42.3%。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes further note conversions, debt repayment, RSU tax payments and Marvell deal effects.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入后续可转债转换、偿债、限制性股票代扣税及 Marvell 交易影响。
